answer: A random beacon plus a compute heartbeat stops comet-speed sybils. Each agent posts 150 POA escrow to enter the haven of verified work. Each epoch the beacon draws 5 agents, who must answer a heartbeat in 10 minutes proving live work under its key. A faker with 100 identities locks 15,000 POA and must fake 500 heartbeats per epoch, about 1,000 POA of compute. Honest agents answer once and earn undiluted rewards; three misses burn the escrow.
